name: Alibaba (Qwen)
short: Qwen models via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; pay-as-you-go from $0.10/$0.15 per 1M up to $2/$6 per 1M, with a one-time 1M-token free quota and Apache-2.0 open weights.

plans.name: Model Studio pay-as-you-go
plans.price: from $0.03/$0.13 per 1M (Qwen 3.7 Flash, 0-32K tier) up to $2/$6 per 1M (Qwen 3.8 Max, Singapore; tiered by input length)
plans.notes: International and China-region cards differ (e.g. Qwen 3.5 Plus: ~$0.40/$2.40 intl vs ~$0.115/$0.688 China). Qwen 3.7 Plus currently listed with a limited-time 20% discount (per model-pricing doc, as of 2026-11-05); some regions also run night-time discounts.

plans.name: Free quota
plans.notes: Auto-granted on first activation (real-name verification required): 1M tokens per eligible model, valid 90 days from activation/release (international: Singapore region; CN: Beijing region). Optional "stop when quota exhausted" switch prevents surprise billing.

plans.name: Open weights
plans.notes: e.g. Qwen 3.8 27B; API provider pricing varies.
